headline: Transindia Real Estate Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Transindia Real Estate Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding issuance of Notice to Equity Shareholders pursuant to the Order passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench in…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Transindia Real Estate Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding issuance of Notice to Equity Shareholders pursuant to the Order passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Madanahatti Logistics and Industrial Parks Private Limited, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company with Transindia Real Estate Limited, the Holding Company
